name: Rockwell

source.label: Business-managed listing (official site live without server-rendered hours)
source.quote: Official Squarespace site confirms the venue ('ROCKWELL', private-event booking, Marina location) but renders no hours server-side; the venue-managed listing grid reads "Thu/Fri/Sat 9:00 PM - 2:00 AM (Next day), Closed Mon-Wed & Sun" and a second save-platform copy repeats the 9PM-2AM Thu-Sat pattern.

access.detail: Fillmore at Union St; the 43 Masonic crosses Fillmore at Clay/Pine nearby and the 30 Stockton runs a few blocks east. Use the live SFMTA planner for exact stop locations; line windows in the Transit tab are for Sunday, September 6, 2026.

flags: Source gap flagged: weekly grid from the business-managed listing, not the official one-page site; the club only opens Thu-Sat at 9 PM, so it is a dedicated night out rather than a pre/midnight drink stop.
Older listings place Rockwell at 1130 Folsom St; the Fillmore location is the current one per multiple 2025-2026 snapshots.

verification.method: Official domain fetched (identity, no hours text); managed listing used for the grid; gap flagged.
